The Manager provides direct and indirect supervision of staff in assigned area; collaborates with the Manager, Systems Sustainability and Safety and individual Subject Matter Experts to develop short- and long-term plans and to ensure the assigned areas meet all Joint Commission and other regulatory requirements.
cond_0516.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Around five (5) years of facilities experience in a healthcare setting, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Background in all trades
Professional Engineering license in mechanical or electrical engineering preferred, or willingness to obtain
Around three (3) years of experience in a supervisory or lead capacity
Internal candidates who do not meet the education requirement may still be considered
cond_0516.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
